blocks.raw: #### **Q: What happens if I don't configure a transformation for my organization?**
blocks.text: Q: What happens if I don't configure a transformation for my organization?

blocks.raw: **A:** The system will use the global default transformation.
blocks.text: A: The system will use the global default transformation.

blocks.raw: #### **Q: Can I have different transformations for different entity types?**
blocks.text: Q: Can I have different transformations for different entity types?

blocks.raw: **A:** Yes, you can configure separate transformations for each entity type.
blocks.text: A: Yes, you can configure separate transformations for each entity type.

blocks.raw: #### **Q: How do I deactivate a transformation?**
blocks.text: Q: How do I deactivate a transformation?

blocks.raw: **A:** Set the `active` field to `false` in your configuration.
blocks.text: A: Set the active field to false in your configuration.

blocks.raw: #### **Q: What happens if my transformation endpoint returns an error?**
blocks.text: Q: What happens if my transformation endpoint returns an error?

blocks.raw: **A:** The system will log the error and the event will be added to a failed events queue.
blocks.text: A: The system will log the error and the event will be added to a failed events queue.

blocks.raw: #### **Q: Can I see my transformation configuration in the UI?**
blocks.text: Q: Can I see my transformation configuration in the UI?

blocks.raw: **A:** Currently, configurations are managed through the API only.
blocks.text: A: Currently, configurations are managed through the API only.

blocks.raw: #### **Q: Is there a limitation on the complexity of transformations?**
blocks.text: Q: Is there a limitation on the complexity of transformations?

blocks.raw: **A:** While there are no strict limitations, complex transformations may impact performance.
blocks.text: A: While there are no strict limitations, complex transformations may impact performance.

blocks.raw: #### **Q: Can I use the same endpoint for multiple entity types?**
blocks.text: Q: Can I use the same endpoint for multiple entity types?

blocks.raw: **A:** Yes, but your endpoint should be able to handle different entity types appropriately.
blocks.text: A: Yes, but your endpoint should be able to handle different entity types appropriately.
